title: feat: enable Azure GPT-6 with consistent 1x pricing
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Routes `openai/gpt-6-sol` and `openai/gpt-6-luna` through Azure `myceli-prod-eastus`, exact `2026-09-22` Global Standard checkpoints, with direct OpenAI Responses fallbacks. Enables Quest Pollen, preserves no aliases, and keeps both at 1×.
- Sets `openai/gpt-6-astra` to 1× too. Preserves its Azure Global primary and existing US Data Zone fallback; fallback costs remain separately attributed while callers keep the primary quote. All three use provider-operated infrastructure.
- Preserves provider rates and adds Sol/Luna image-input rates. Exact short/long-context and cache rates match [Microsoft’s GPT-6 price table](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/gpt-6-astra-sol-and-luna-for-production-agents-in-microsoft-foundry/) and [OpenAI pricing](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing).
- Verified 809 focused tests after updating from `main`, Gen/Enter typechecks, local build/catalog, and direct-provider text, two-image vision, tools, structured output, streaming, reasoning, errors, cache writes/hits, and 20-request bursts for Azure Sol/Luna.
- Verified the local authenticated gateway with a Quest-only account: Azure primary attribution, 1× billing, Quest Pollen debit, zero paid balance, output-cache reuse without a second debit, and forced Azure-to-OpenAI fallback with one final billed event. The temporary local key was deleted after testing.

gist.headline: Three new minds, one price
gist.blurb: Sol and Luna have landed in the hive through Azure, with Astra joining them at a clean 1× rate. Quest Pollen can now feed all three without needing a small billing archaeology expedition.
gist.summary: Added Azure Global routing for `openai/gpt-6-sol` and `openai/gpt-6-luna` via `myceli-prod-eastus` with direct OpenAI Responses fallbacks, enabled Quest Pollen for both, and standardized GPT-6 Astra, Sol, and Luna at 1× pricing with image-input, cache, and context-specific provider rates.
gist.impact: Developers can call all three GPT-6 models at a consistent 1× quote using paid balance or Quest Pollen, including vision, tools, structured output, streaming, reasoning, and cached responses while provider fallback remains seamless.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model-routing garden: three labeled glowing seed pods for Astra, Sol, and Luna sit on an Azure-blue-but-pastel cloud server, each fed by the same 1× watering line. Polli, wearing tiny accountant glasses and carrying a Pollen coin watering can, checks the equal flow while code-plants and flowers grow around the server; a small fallback path connects to a retro OpenAI-style response terminal.
